name: DATINGSIMPOCALYPSE 2013
source:
A simple parody of the dating sim genre in which you simply can't win.
Try to get all four special endings and "successfully romance" all three characters!

[From [url=https://www.newgrounds.com/portal/view/622043]Newgrounds[/url]]
translation:
这是对约会模拟游戏类型的简单模仿，在其中你根本无法获胜。
尝试获得所有四个特殊结局并“成功地浪漫”所有三个角色！

[来自[url=https://www.newgrounds.com/portal/view/622043]Newgrounds[/url]]
